name: loan_amortization
description: Loan instalment and full amortization schedule for the French (constant payment), German (constant principal) and American (interest only, bullet) systems, from a nominal annual rate and payments per year. Early repayments at any period, shortening the term or lowering the instalment, with the interest they save; totals of interest and payments. Decimal arithmetic, cents per period, the last payment absorbing the remainder.

periods.description: Number of payments; or give years

years.description: Term in years; years x payments_per_year must be whole

period.description: Paid right after this period's regular payment

catalog.source: original; the instalment is the annuity formula of Excel PMT and numpy-financial pmt, whose documentation examples the tests reproduce
